[[2007 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament]] }} '''Terrence Williams''' (Also known as T-Will) (born [[June 28]] [[1987]] in [[Seattle]], [[Washington]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player. He is the senior co-captain for [[Rick Pitino]]'s [[2008-09 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|2008-09]] [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|University of Louisville Cardinals]]. He is a 6-foot-6 [[forward (basketball)|forward]] hailing from Seattle, Washington. During the 2007-08 season, Williams achieved only the third and fourth [[triple-double]]s in Louisville basketball history (the first two by [[Samaki Walker]] and [http://www.uoflsports.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/myles_ellis00.html Ellis Myles]). He racked up 14 points, 13 assists and 12 rebounds in the Cardinals' season-opening 104-69 win over [[University of Hartford|Hartford]][http://sports.yahoo.com/ncaab/recap?gid=200711170314 NCAA Basketball - Hartford Hawks/Louisville Cardinals Recap Saturday November 17, 2007 - Yahoo! Sports] and had 10 points, 10 rebounds, and 10 assists in a [[January 19]], [[2008]] loss to [[Seton Hall Pirates|Seton Hall]]{{cite web |url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/boxscore?gameId=280192550 |title=Louisville-Seton Hall Box Score |accessdate=2008-02-24 |last= |first= |coauthors= |date= |work= |publisher=ESPN}}. At Rainier Beach High School, Williams was a four-year starter on the basketball team. He helped the team to a state title in 2003. He averaged 21.7 points his senior year. He was also a starting wide receiver and free safety on the [[american football|football]] team. He considered attending [[Indiana University (Bloomington)|Indiana]] and [[University of Kansas|Kansas]] before deciding to play for Pitino.[http://uoflsports.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/williams_terrence00.html Player Bio: Terrence Williams :: Men's Basketball] Williams appeared on back-to-back Sports Illustrated covers [http://www.courier-journal.com/blogs/bozich/2009/03/u-of-l-snubbed-in-big-east-awards.html U of L snubbed in Big East awards] and is one of few athletes to do so. He is also a finalist in the Lowe's Senior Class Award[http://www.seniorclassaward.com/news/view/lowes_senior_class_award_announces_finalists_for_the_ncaa_division_i_mens_a/ LOWE’S SENIOR CLASS AWARD ANNOUNCES FINALISTS FOR NCAA® DIVISION I MEN’S & WOMEN’S BASKETBALL]. Williams' has extraordinary overall athletic abilities as recognized by coach [[Rick Pitino]]. "He's a freakish athlete," Pitino says [http://www.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/2007-10-25-sw-louisville-williams_N.htm Williams, Louisville won't sneak up on opponents - USATODAY.com]. He is known for his [[slam dunk]]ing abilities and won the dunk contest at the 2005 Kentucky Derby Basketball Classic [http://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&ct=res&cd=1&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.draftexpress.com%2Fprofile%2FTerrence-Williams-507%2F&ei=gcS_SaOeKYzanQfviaUp&usg=AFQjCNELJ-a3fR9SVVrQL53k787wwrFiKw&sig2=nEoMRkmXrdh2qKBACn31mA DraftExpress NBA Draft Prospect Profile: Terrence Williams, Stats, Comparisons, and Outlook]. Williams is a [[potential]] first round selection in the [[2009 NBA Draft]].{{cite web | url=http://www.nbadraftdepot.com/2009/01/2009-nba-mock-draft.html| title=Draft Depot - 2009 NBA Mock Draft | publisher = | accessdate=2009-05-28}} He is a shoe fanatic, owning over 300 pairs. [http://www.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/2007-10-25-sw-louisville-williams_N.htm Williams, Louisville won't sneak up on opponents - USATODAY.com] His nickname is King Bull.
